children: 1-800-Flowers.com entered into a Third Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement to increase financial flexibility and adjust covenants. The amendment introduces a minimum liquidity covenant through the fiscal quarter ending Sep 26, 2027, then shifts to a minimum consolidated EBITDA covenant from the quarter ending Dec 26, 2027 through the Affected Period. It expands asset sale permissions, allowing the company to retain up to $30 million of proceeds after a minimum $15 million prepayment on the term loan, and adds limits on transferring material IP to non-guarantor subsidiaries. The Affected Period also includes monthly lender calls and added revolver prepayment obligations.
